content:
maria: Heads-up  sketching a new onboarding flow that balances bench coverage and cost. Need quick feedback on tradeoffs and interfaces.
aj: Stratified sampling by seqlen + prompt-type catches weird tail regressions, strongly +1.
sachin: Can we fold this into golden-sampler infra? duplicating runs will hit budget hard.
leo: Proposed pipeline: smoke (sanity checks), perf (mini-bench), quality (goldset). Smoke must be tiny (<2s) and detect tokenizer/manifest problems.
maria: Smoke runs 3 sanity prompts, tokenizer roundtrip checks, and a quick model load check. Perf runs N samples per bucket, reports p50/p95 latencies and per-token cost deltas. Quality runs goldset metrics for quality regressions.
aj: Drift hooks question: admission vs async post-deploy? Admission prevents bad models early but slows iteration.
sachin: Hard-fail admission on obvious incompat (tokenizer mismatch, model load errors). Soft-fail drift checks should be async with alerting + automated rollback policies.
maria: Onboard API contract sketch: {gate_status, stage, reasons[], artifacts_url}  concise and machine readable.
leo: Example RFC config: ```json
{"smoke_window_s":4, "mini_bench_samples":50, "goldset_eval":true, "kv_warmup_seqlens":[1,8,64,256]}
```
aj: Add KV/cache smoke: warmup across seqlens, validate kv hit-rate and kv memory deltas; fail if >X% increase.
probe-bot: Reminder: org policy limits mini-bench to 10m default per model. Overrides require eng-ml approval.
maria: Canary policy: if goldset delta > threshold, route 5% traffic to previous model for 24h and auto-rollback on SLO breaches.
sachin: Telemetry tags: onboard.model, onboard.run_id, sample_bucket, bench.stage, bench.run_time. Important for traceability.
aj: I'll mock a dashboard with sampling coverage, p95 delta, and goldset drift.
leo: Also add determinism check: same prompt twice, compare logits/top-k stability to catch nondeterministic kernels.
maria: Next: I'll open an RFC with API contract, sampling plan, and cost estimate; please add perf constraints and goldset sizing. Will post link here when ready. :slightly_smiling_face:
